[[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] '''2b fission engines''', also called simply '''2b engines''', were an upgraded variant of [[2a fission engine/Legends|2a fission engines]], commonly installed on [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]]. ''[[Dire Hound]]'' was equipped with those upgraded engines, as noted by [[Kath Scarlet]].
